title: Add a small feature (JavaScript)
prompt: Add a method `total(discountPercent = 0)` to the Cart class in cart.js. It returns the sum of price times quantity over all lines, reduced by the discount percentage and rounded to 2 decimals, as a number. Example: lines of 10.00 x 2 and 5.50 x 1 with a 10 percent discount give 22.95. Then run `{node} --test` to check that the existing tests still pass.
